title: SSU's Alpha special forces take out over 4,300 Russian troops in one week
summary: Special forces of the Alpha Special Operations Center of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) neutralized 4,333 Russian troops in one week.

title: Finland seeking over €25 bln in compensation from Russia and Gazprom
summary: Finland is seeking to recover more than €25 billion from Russia and its state-owned gas producer Gazprom.

title: State Special Transport Service deminers clear over 230,000 hectares of liberated territory
summary: Demining teams from the State Special Transport Service (SSTS) of Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense have surveyed and cleared more than 230,000 hectares of territory liberated from Russian forces.
